description: A React component named Radio that renders a set of radio buttons for sorting options, managing its own state and notifying parent components of changes.

classes.name: Radio
classes.description: A React component for selecting sorting options via radio buttons, managing internal state and communicating changes upward.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Radio component with default state and binds the handleChange method.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change events from radio inputs, updating internal state and calling a parent callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the radio button options for sorting, with labels and checked states based on internal state.
